Aditya / team — below are the technical responses I will include in the questionnaire; I also attached an evidence bundle (redwood_iam_evidence_package.zip) with sample SAML metadata, SCIM sync logs, and screenshots of admin audit logs. Summary: 

1) SAML / OIDC
- We support SAML 2.0 (IdP-initiated and SP-initiated). ACS endpoints and SP metadata are hosted at https://auth.redwood.com/saml/metadata.
- We also support OIDC (openid, profile, email) for modern integrations.
- SAML NameID formats supported: persistent, transient, and email. Default recommendation: use transient for short-lived sessions; persistent where user linking is required.

2) SCIM
- SCIM 2.0 provisioning supported (PATCH/PUT/POST/DELETE).
- Core attributes supported: userName, givenName, familyName, displayName, emails[type=work], active, externalId, groups. Custom attributes via extension schema supported on request.
- Optional: incremental sync using ETag and filtered queries.

3) RBAC & Admin Controls
- Role model: Organization Admin, Org Viewer, App Admin, App Operator, Read-Only Auditor.
- Admin delegation: Organization Admins can create and assign roles. App Admins can manage app-level configs but cannot modify organization-level billing or security settings.
- Built-in separation-of-duty guardrails and approval workflows for elevated roles (via an approvals queue).

4) Audit & Logging
- Admin action audit logs: captured for all create/update/delete on roles, user assignments, and security settings.
- Retention: default 24 months; configurable up to 36 months for enterprise customers. Logs stored encrypted at rest in customer-separated buckets when on Dedicated/Private deployments.

5) Encryption / Key Management
- TLS 1.2+ in transport. Data at rest is AES-256. Customer-managed keys via KMS/HSM supported for Private and Dedicated tiers.

Attachments included in bundle: SAML_sp_metadata.xml, scim_sample_patch.json, admin_audit_samples.log, control_mapping_SOC2.xlsx

I'll populate the spreadsheet with these answers and include short snippets for attribute mapping. ETA: I'll have the first pass to Marissa by EOD Feb 19.

— Priyom
